Yes, fashion designs can be protected under copyright law, but only to a limited extent [d1]. Clothing designs are considered useful articles and are not protected by copyright in the same way as other creative works; copyright protection typically only applies to the graphic designs, textile patterns, and logos on a garment if they exhibit sufficient creativity or originality, while the underlying functional aspects remain unprotected [d4][d1].
